paragraphs: The V300 Exclusive is the top-spec people-mover trim of the Vito range. It uses the OM654 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo-diesel producing 174kW and 500Nm. This is the same engine family used across the wider W447 Vito range in different states of tune, from the entry-level Vito 114 (100kW/300Nm) up to the V300 Exclusive's flagship output. The V300 Exclusive sits at the top of the current range, and the OM654 is the latest-generation diesel unit powering the 2025-refreshed models.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every V300 EXCLUSIVE on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo-diesel fitted to the V300 Exclusive from the 2025 refresh onwards. This is the current-generation engine across the W447 Vito range in various states of tune, with the V300 Exclusive receiving the highest output at 174kW/500Nm.
